Safeguard of Judiciary Data In terms of the performance of this contract, the Judiciary will provide the contractor with proprietary data that includes Personally Identifiable Information (PII) that is not available to the public. The contractor shall take every precaution to safeguard all Judiciary provided data and adhere to the following judiciary clauses: 7-20, Security Requirements and 7-35, Disclosure or Use of Information. In no event will the contractor permit any Judiciary data to be accessed, handled, used, processed, or viewed by any individual who has not been properly screened in accordance with clause 7-20, nor shall the contractor permit any data to be handled, stored, or processed except in strict adherence to the limitations in clause 7-35.
